decisions.reason: The schlager compilation is a low-cost catalog item that fits the firm's established music retail line, and it had its own page for two years, so management is inclined to keep it in stock rather than admit the launch failed.
The illustrated release series is a visible multi-year commitment that shapes the firm's profile, and weak results can be blamed on the pandemic disrupting retail, so management persists with it.

The jazz vinyl reissue required licensing and pressing investment and fits the vinyl revival the firm has aligned itself with, so sunk costs and the plausibility of a temporary slump favor keeping it.
The multi-disc box set represents substantial production and inventory investment that management wants to recover, and it can still sell as a premium catalog item, so it stays on the market.
The compilation CD was only mentioned on the website and never given its own page, so commitment and investment are low, and it is the easiest product to drop in a shrinking CD market.
